decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension & porch hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension and porch are used

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in thenorth and south wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: DEMOLITION OF FLANK STORE AND REAR LEAN-TO AND ERECTION OF SINGLE STOREY SIDE AND REAR EXTENSION TO DWELLINGHOUSE INCORPORATING FRONT PORCH
